SELECT cycle_products.id AS id, 'Inv Adj' AS type, cycle_products.date AS `date`, cycle_products.reference AS reference, CONCAT_WS(' ',users.first_name,users.last_name) AS approvedBy, locations.name AS locationName, cycle_product_details.qty_difference AS qty, products.price_uom_id AS priceUomId, CASE WHEN products.small_val_uom = 1 THEN (SELECT abbr FROM uoms WHERE id = priceUomId) ELSE (SELECT abbr FROM uoms INNER JOIN uom_conversions ON uom_conversions.to_uom_id = uoms.id WHERE from_uom_id = priceUomId AND is_small_uom = 1 AND uom_conversions.is_active = 1 ORDER BY uom_conversions.id DESC LIMIT 1) END AS uomName, IFNULL(cost,0) / products.small_val_uom AS unitCost FROM cycle_products INNER JOIN cycle_product_details ON cycle_products.id = cycle_product_details.cycle_product_id INNER JOIN inventory_valuations ON inventory_valuations.cycle_product_id = cycle_products.id AND inventory_valuations.pid = cycle_product_details.product_id INNER JOIN products ON products.id = cycle_product_details.product_id INNER JOIN users ON users.id = cycle_products.created_by INNER JOIN locations ON cycle_product_details.location_id = locations.id WHERE cycle_products.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND cycle_products.status > 0 AND products.id = #{productId} GROUP BY cycle_products.id, cycle_products.reference ORDER BY cycle_products.date

SELECT cycle_products.id AS id, (SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = cycle_product_details.product_id) AS productName, SUM(cycle_product_details.qty_difference) AS qty, products.price_uom_id AS priceUomId, CASE WHEN products.small_val_uom = 1 THEN (SELECT abbr FROM uoms WHERE id = priceUomId) ELSE (SELECT abbr FROM uoms INNER JOIN uom_conversions ON uom_conversions.to_uom_id = uoms.id WHERE from_uom_id = priceUomId AND is_small_uom = 1 AND uom_conversions.is_active = 1 ORDER BY uom_conversions.id DESC LIMIT 1) END AS uomName, IFNULL(cost,0) / products.small_val_uom AS unitCost, SUM((IFNULL(cost,0) / products.small_val_uom) * qty_difference) AS totalCost FROM cycle_products INNER JOIN cycle_product_details ON cycle_products.id = cycle_product_details.cycle_product_id INNER JOIN inventory_valuations ON inventory_valuations.cycle_product_id = cycle_products.id AND inventory_valuations.pid = cycle_product_details.product_id INNER JOIN products ON products.id = cycle_product_details.product_id INNER JOIN users ON users.id = cycle_products.created_by LEFT JOIN locations ON cycle_product_details.location_id = locations.id WHERE cycle_products.status >= 0 AND cycle_products.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId})
AND products.id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE parent_id = #{parentId})

SELECT inventory_valuations.type AS type, inventory_valuations.date AS `date`, CASE WHEN cycle_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT reference FROM cycle_products WHERE id = cycle_product_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN sales_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT so_code FROM sales_orders WHERE id = sales_order_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN point_of_sales_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT so_code FROM sales_orders WHERE id = point_of_sales_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN credit_memo_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT cm_code FROM credit_memos WHERE id = credit_memo_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT po_code FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = purchase_order_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN purchase_return_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT pr_code FROM purchase_returns WHERE id = purchase_return_id LIMIT 1 ) ELSE IFNULL(inventory_valuations.reference, '') END AS reference, IFNULL(inventory_valuations.small_qty, 0) AS qty, IFNULL(inventory_valuations.cost, 0) AS cost, IFNULL(inventory_valuations.price, 0) AS price, IFNULL(inventory_valuations.on_hand_small, 0) AS onHand, IFNULL(inventory_valuations.avg_cost, 0) AS avgCost, IFNULL(inventory_valuations.qty, 0) * IFNULL(inventory_valuations.avg_cost, 0) AS assetValue, IFNULL(inventory_valuations.is_var_cost, 0) AS isVarCost, IFNULL(inventory_valuations.is_adjust_value, 0) AS isAdjustValue, COALESCE( (SELECT uoms.name FROM uoms WHERE uoms.id IN ( SELECT uom_conversions.to_uom_id FROM uom_conversions WHERE uom_conversions.from_uom_id = products.price_uom_id AND uom_conversions.is_small_uom = 1 AND uom_conversions.is_active = 1 )), (SELECT uoms.name FROM uoms WHERE uoms.id = products.price_uom_id) ) AS uom FROM inventory_valuations INNER JOIN products ON products.id = inventory_valuations.pid WHERE inventory_valuations.is_active = 1 AND inventory_valuations.pid = #{productId} ORDER BY inventory_valuations.date, inventory_valuations.created, inventory_valuations.id ASC

COALESCE( (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE vendors.id = inv.vendor_id LIMIT 1), (SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customers.id = inv.customer_id LIMIT 1), (SELECT CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) FROM users WHERE users.id = inv.created_by LIMIT 1) ) AS createdBy,

CASE WHEN cycle_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT IFNULL(cost, 0) / p.small_val_uom FROM inventory_valuations WHERE inventory_valuations.cycle_product_id = inv.cycle_product_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN sales_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT unit_price FROM sales_order_details WHERE sales_order_details.sales_order_id = inv.sales_order_id AND sales_order_details.product_id = inv.product_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN point_of_sales_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT unit_price FROM sales_order_details WHERE sales_order_details.sales_order_id = inv.point_of_sales_id AND sales_order_details.product_id = inv.product_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN credit_memo_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT unit_price FROM credit_memo_details WHERE credit_memo_details.credit_memo_id = inv.credit_memo_id AND credit_memo_details.product_id = inv.product_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT unit_cost * -1 FROM purchase_order_details WHERE purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id = inv.purchase_order_id AND purchase_order_details.product_id = inv.product_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN transfer_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT cost FROM inventory_valuations WHERE is_active = 1 AND pid = inv.product_id AND date <= inv.date ORDER BY date DESC, created DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHEN purchase_return_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT unit_price FROM purchase_return_details WHERE purchase_return_details.purchase_return_id = inv.purchase_return_id AND purchase_return_details.product_id = inv.product_id LIMIT 1 ) ELSE 0 END AS unitCost,
CASE WHEN cycle_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT reference FROM cycle_products WHERE id = cycle_product_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN sales_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT so_code FROM sales_orders WHERE id = sales_order_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN point_of_sales_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT so_code FROM sales_orders WHERE id = point_of_sales_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN credit_memo_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT cm_code FROM credit_memos WHERE id = credit_memo_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT po_code FROM purchase_orders WHERE id = purchase_order_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN purchase_return_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT pr_code FROM purchase_returns WHERE id = purchase_return_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN transfer_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT to_code FROM transfer_orders WHERE id = transfer_order_id LIMIT 1 ) WHEN purchase_receive_result_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT code FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE id = purchase_receive_result_id LIMIT 1 ) ELSE 'Unknown' END AS reference
FROM inventories inv INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = inv.product_id INNER JOIN locations l ON l.id = inv.location_id

FROM inventories inv INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = inv.product_id INNER JOIN uoms u ON u.id = p.price_uom_id LEFT JOIN users usr ON usr.id = p.created_by INNER JOIN locations l ON l.id = inv.location_id INNER JOIN location_groups lg ON lg.id = inv.location_group_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = inv.customer_id LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = inv.vendor_id LEFT JOIN purchase_receive_results po ON po.purchase_order_id = inv.purchase_order_id LEFT JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = inv.sales_order_id LEFT JOIN sales_orders pos ON pos.id = inv.point_of_sales_id LEFT JOIN credit_memos cm ON cm.id = inv.credit_memo_id LEFT JOIN transfer_receive_results tr ON tr.transfer_order_id = inv.transfer_order_id LEFT JOIN cycle_products ia ON ia.id = inv.cycle_product_id LEFT JOIN purchase_returns ON purchase_returns.id = inv.purchase_return_id LEFT JOIN purchase_receive_results ON purchase_receive_results.id = inv.purchase_receive_result_id
